en: A black and white postcard showing a busy bus station with several buses, trucks, and people in a relatively open area. The background shows forested hills and several buildings. The lower left corner of the photo side reads 'SUNDSVALL. Busstationen'. The correspondence side includes handwritten text in Swedish, a stamp of Sweden featuring a profile of a man, and an address to Sundersdorp. The postcard has a wavy border typical of mid-20th-century postcards.
